notes.title: Big Update! (Plus other stuff)
notes.notes:
Hey bouncers! How's it going? We've just released the first ever update (woo!) so get hyper!

This update includes the most requested fix, so that's great, turns out it was a small overlooked thing and it's all good now!

In the meantime, we've also set up a discord! Wooo, it's a bit bare bones now but i'm sure as a community we can make it even better. Links below

I also have a patreon, so if you fancy chucking us a couple (or a few) bucks, we'd be grateful - links below!

We also have a twitter, follow us there - link below!
